subject: Confirming quote got to you — quick 15m ride‑along to run numbers?
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@cloudcraft.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cloudcraft follow-up & pricing packet

Hi Alex / Priya —

Really appreciated the time earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from my side:

- Attached: Redwood pricing + configuration deck and a tailored capacity estimate for the sample workload you shared.
- What we built in the estimate: a Dedicated pool with autoscale burst, 24/7 baseline, and a small hot-cache for low‑latency inference on short queries. You’ll see token-level cost and a monthly committed SKU breakdown on slide 4.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Quick 15‑minute ride‑along where I’ll walk through the pricing line items and the expected latency/cost tradeoffs.
2) Confirm whether data residency (us-east) and KMS integration are blockers for procurement.

Proposed slots: Tue 5/19 10:00am PT or Wed 5/20 3:00pm PT. If neither work, drop a couple times and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_deck_2027-05.pdf (PDF) — capacity_estimate_cloudcraft_2027.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555‑0123 | tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
https://redwood.ai

---
On Mon, 2027-05-18 at 12:03 PM Alex Chen <alex@cloudcraft.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the call, Tessa. The breakdown looks useful — I shared the deck with procurement.
> —Alex
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@cloudcraft.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Quick check — priorities shifted?

Hi Alex —

Just circling back on the pricing packet I sent last week (attached again here) — curious if this is still a priority for Cloudcraft this quarter or if timelines shifted. I know procurement sometimes needs an internal summary; happy to draft a one‑page SOW summary for you if that helps move things along.

If you’re still interested, I can do a quick 15‑minute walk through the numbers and highlight where we can compress costs (quantization + prefix caching) without changing SLAs. My Calendly is here: https://calendly.com/redwood-tessa/15min.

If this isn’t the right cadence, would you prefer I check back in 2–3 weeks instead?

Best,
Tessa

Attachments: redwood_pricing_deck_2027-05.pdf

> On Fri, 2027-05-18 at 3:12 PM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Alex Chen <alex@cloudcraft.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-25T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cloudcraft follow-up & pricing packet

Hey Tessa —

Apologies for the delay — procurement did get pulled into another review last week. I did see the deck and the estimate looks reasonable. Wed 5/26 at 3:00pm PT works for a short run‑through — can you send an invite?

Two quick asks for the call:
- Can you highlight the expected token burn assumptions behind slide 4? We want to validate the 30% caching improvement assumption.
- Any guidance on a staged rollout to keep e2e latency under 150ms during peak?

If you can include Markus on the invite (I cc'd him here), that would be great. Thanks —
Alex Chen
Director, Platform Engineering — Cloudcraft
alex@cloudcraft.ai
